items.md: The department of labor and industries (L&I) is withdrawing the CR-102 proposed rule making filed on February 3, 2026, and published under WSR 26-04-112. The comment period for the proposed rule making was from February 4, 2026, to March 10, 2026.
items.value: The department of labor and industries (L&I) is withdrawing the CR-102 proposed rule making filed on February 3, 2026, and published under WSR 26-04-112. The comment period for the proposed rule making was from February 4, 2026, to March 10, 2026.

items.md: Due to technology resource constraints and uncertainty about our ability to prioritize this work, L&I is not able to make system changes to support the requirements of this rule change. For this reason, we have decided to withdraw the rule making. L&I will revisit implementation and system options, consult with stakeholders, and file a new CR-101 preproposal if/when appropriate.
